posts.meta_description:
1,412 likes, 86 comments - simonsinek on October 29, 2026: "Somewhere along the way, we turned longevity into a competition: who can look the youngest, live the longest, biohack the best. But to what end? 

Everyone leading the longevity movement seems to have something to sell you. Diets, workshops, supplements, then more supplements.

But gerontologist Dr. Kerry Burnight (@the_gerontologist) sees something we keep missing: there’s profound beauty in growing older. 

We made aging a competitive sport. Kerry wants us to make it a celebration—and that might just be the key to actually improving longevity.

Check out the full episode of A Bit of Optimism wherever you get your podcasts 🎧".

posts.meta_description:
4,038 likes, 159 comments - simonsinek on October 27, 2026: "“You don’t look your age!” While it sounds like a compliment, what if we weren’t so afraid of ‘looking our age?’

Gerontologist Dr. Kerry Burnight (@the_gerontologist) says comments like this are a sign of how deep society’s ageism runs.

She says the research is clear: a lot of things get BETTER as we get older. Maybe it’s time we start embracing getting to age, knowing the good parts are still to come.

🎧 Listen to the full episode of A Bit of Optimism wherever you get your podcasts.".
